annotations.title: Get ICE and CBP Contract Totals

description: ICE and CBP contract obligation totals from the Pay-to-Play Register, by component (ICE, CBP or both, default both) and fiscal year (2025, 2026, or both when fy is omitted): the funding view (contracts funded from the component's own appropriations, the headline measure) with the awarding view and the bridge between the two beside it, ICE and CBP combined in the funding view, and the share held by the 5, 10 and 25 largest parents. Also the P.L. 119-21 border wall system (Sec. 90001, CBP) by stage: appropriated, obligated and outlaid, each with its own as-of date; the two laws' lines by program activity, labelled where the program activity's name cites the law and shown as probable where only the account's availability window matches, never counted as the law's money; and the register's eight headlines with their basis and as-of dates. Appropriated, obligated and outlaid are separate stages and are never added. Contract obligations are orders placed and contracts signed, not outlays (money paid out). Every answer carries the register's question note and caption: the records are shown side by side and do not show that one caused another.

fy.description: Optional federal fiscal year, 2025 or 2026 (FY2026 runs October 2025 to September 2026); both when omitted.
